view: Old Goa St Augustine church ruined single massive square laterite tower remnant, four weathered arched levels and broken summit, oblique view from roofless nave foundations with tropical palms behind. Tower fragment not complete church, no intact twin towers, no Gothic fantasy.

eras.title: The remaining tower
eras.caption: The ruined church of St Augustine leaves a tall fragment of tower above Old Goa. Other churches nearby remain in use, but this broken complex records a different fate within the former capital of Portuguese India.
